exposure: late gestational weight gain rate (late GWGr)
cohort: The study analyzed 6235 singleton pregnancies among women with normal pre-pregnancy body mass index.
finding: Prompt control of gestational weight gain rate, even during late pregnancy, was beneficial to improving maternal and neonatal pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Excessive gestational weight gain rates, particularly in the second and third trimesters, were consistently associated with a higher risk of cesarean section.
